zh: 上火车跟上车一样。注意空隙，还有那些电线。
en: Enter a train like a car. Mind the gap - and those electric lines.

zh: 定期火车让你在城里来去方便。上火车跟上车一样。
en: The regular train service means easy trips around the city. Enter a train like a car.

zh: 把车开到四个码头任意一处的吊车下面，能拿额外分数。
en: Dump vehicles under the cranes at any one of the four docks for extra points.

zh: 城里有四个码头。让吊车把车吊走，能拿奖励分。
en: There are four docks in the city. Let the cranes pick up vehicles for bonus points.

zh: 条子咬得很紧？去喷漆店换个颜色或车牌。
en: The cops hot on your tail? Try a Respray Shop for a new color or license plates.

zh: 喷漆店能让条子从你屁股上下来。花钱换颜色或车牌。
en: Respray Shops get the cops off your ass. Change your color or plates for a price.

zh: 开进炸弹店，给车装上定时炸弹。攻击键启动炸弹。记住：站远点！
en: Drive into a Bomb Shop to fit a timer and bomb to a vehicle. The Attack Key arms the bomb. Remember - stand well back!

zh: 炸弹店花钱给车装炸弹。开进去，开出来，开走。用攻击键启动炸药。
en: Bomb Shops fit bombs to vehicles for cash. Drive in, out and off. Use the Attack Key to arm the explosives.

zh: 把你最爱的车开进炸弹店，花钱装颗炸弹。攻击键启动炸弹。
en: Fit your favorite vehicle with a bomb in exchange for cash by simply driving into a Bomb Shop. The Attack Key arms the bomb.

zh: 有些楼里藏着院子。进去看看，有些绝妙的惊喜。
en: Some buildings conceal courtyard areas. Check them out for a few fab surprises.

zh: 有空去看看西福特洛高架桥底下那辆车。
en: When you get time, check out the car under the railway lines in West Fort Law.

zh: 卡住了？法岛有辆卡车丢在那儿好几天了……
en: Stuck? A truck in Law Island has been abandoned for the past few days...

zh: 装了炸弹的车，撞得太狠，或者速度掉到一定以下，就会炸。
en: Vehicles fitted with bombs will blow if they get too badly damaged or they drop below a certain speed.

zh: 看你的传呼机。老大用它透露别的活的消息。
en: Watch your pager. The boss uses it to reveal information about other jobs.

zh: 老大经常用传呼机交代活，看着点。
en: The boss often uses the pager to provide information about jobs, so watch it.

zh: 跟条子硬碰硬不聪明。但记住喷漆店！
en: It's wise to avoid police confrontation. But remember the Respray Shops!

zh: 箭头永远指向目标，但别靠它认路。
en: The arrow always points to your goal, but don't rely on it for navigation.

zh: 等车库门打开，再往楼里开。
en: Wait for the garage door to open before attempting to drive into the building.

zh: 东西一到手，条子就会像疹子一样爬满你。警告过你了。
en: Once the pickup's made, the cops'll be all over ya like a rash. You were warned.

zh: 要接人，就开对的车靠近他们。
en: To pick up people, drive up close to them in the appropriate vehicle.

zh: 你需要一百万分开下一关。
en: You need one million points to progress.

zh: 偷那辆摩托时，准备好立刻跑。天使帮会气疯！
en: When you steal the bike, be prepared for a fast getaway. The Angels'll be pissed!

zh: 记住喷漆店的位置。甩条子全靠它们。
en: Note the locations of the Respray Shops. They are essential for confusing cops.

zh: 蹭它。现在就蹭。来啊，别害羞。哦来啊。蹭它。快点！来啊！蹭！贱人。
en: Rub it. Rub it now. Come on, don't be shy. Oh come on. Rub it. Faster! Come ON! RUB! Bitch.

zh: 做点出人意料的，往往比听话报酬更大。
en: Doing the unexpected often brings greater rewards than following orders.

zh: 装满炸药的车悠着点开。颠太多次就会炸！
en: Take it easy with vehicles packed with explosives. Too many bumps and they blow!

zh: 停在警局正中间，破坏最大。
en: Park in the center of the precinct to cause most damage.

zh: 灭掉一帮人最好用自动武器。要快！
en: The best way to wipe out a gang is to use an automatic weapon. Be quick!

zh: 要开吊车，先开到它下面，提示时下车。大多数车都能换钱。
en: To start a crane, drive under it then get out of the vehicle when prompted. Most vehicles can be dumped for cash.

zh: 亲爱的，我想碰碰运气留下这段话，希望你看见，想起我们的爱。记得事后删掉！我永远爱你。
en: Darling, I thought I'd take a chance and add this message in the hope you'd see it and think of our love. Remember to delete it afterwards! I love you always.

zh: 帮里的人大多有枪，附近总有接应。眼睛放亮！
en: Most gang members are armed and backup's always in the area. Keep your eyes open!

zh: 干得漂亮，领头的！油门踩死！
en: Way t' go, leader! Keep ya foot down!
C'mon, sloth turd! Step on it!

zh: 妈的！这辆巴士装了500磅塑胶炸药。
en: Shit! This bus is rigged with 500 lbs of plastic.

zh: 也好，省得收拾这天大的烂摊子！
en: Well, that saved cleaning up the mother of all messes!
Come back when ya got the cash!
I ain't touchin' that! Get outta here!

zh: 把那该死的玩具给我弄走！
en: Get that goddamn toy outta here!

zh: 我看起来像军队吗？去炸你自己吧，小子！
en: What do I look like? The military? Go blow, punk!
There ya go! Good as new!
It's clean. The plates have been changed.
That cost you ALL your cash.

zh: 又来一辆？想象力呢，小子？
en: Another one? Where's your imagination, kid?

zh: 这玩意儿都要从我屁股里冒出来了！下次换点别的！
en: I got these things comin' out my ass! Try somethin' different next time!

zh: 你真以为我会碰那辆装满炸弹的破车？滚！
en: You really think I'm gonna touch that bomb-loaded shit? Get outta here!

zh: 那玩意儿这儿放不下。从我眼前弄走！
en: That ain't gonna fit on here. Get it outta my sight!
I'm outta service. Try another crane!

zh: 我可不是慈善机构！把那破车弄走！
en: I ain't a charity! Get that wreck outta here!

zh: 把你的屁股挪开，我要吊了！
en: Get your buns outta there, I'm pickin' it up!

zh: 我没地方了！拿到别处去！
en: I ain't got room for no more! Take it someplace else!

zh: 急什么，小子？给我点时间！
en: What's your hurry kid? Gimme a chance!

zh: 火看着挺漂亮，但我可不收着火的！
en: The flames look real pretty, but I ain't takin' it like that!

zh: 没门，小子！这对我太烫了！
en: No way kid! That's too hot for me!

zh: 这东西不太有人要……不过管他的。
en: There ain't much demand for these... but what the hell.

zh: 这个我不收！你想陷害我吗，小子？
en: I ain't takin' that! You tryin' to set me up kid?
Excellent condition. I'll give you $%d for it.
Good condition. I'll give you $%d for it.
Not too bad. How does $%d grab ya?
Pretty beat up... I can only give ya $%d for it.

zh: 真是坨屎！给你%d块，就这些！
en: What a pieceashit! You get $%d an' that's all!

zh: 老大对你的进度不满意。你能活着就算走运……直到公司让你后悔没死。
en: The boss ain't happy with ya progress. Consider y'self lucky to be alive... until the company makes ya wish you were dead.

zh: 你以为老大会把你捞出来吧……现在公司没人罩你了。
en: Bet ya thought the boss would get ya off... Well there ain't no-one from the company around to look out for ya now.

zh: 真是个人物！你妈会骄傲的！
en: What a guy! Your moma would be proud!

zh: 怂包，嗯？下次我去商场给你带根脊梁回来！
en: Chickenshit, huh? Next time I'm at the mall I'll bring ya back a spine!

zh: 你这蠢屎废物。这么简单的活要拖他妈多久？公司不高兴。
en: You dumb shit loser. How goddamn long can such a simple mission take? The company ain't happy.

zh: 时间到！%s以%d块巨款获胜，%s以%d块屈居第二！
en: TIME UP! %s WINS with a monumental $%d, %s brings up second with %d!
%s HITS THE TARGET! The winning score is %d!

zh: 时间到了，倒霉蛋！还想玩？去买正版。
en: Time's up, sucker! Ya want more? Buy the real thing.

zh: 光盘不可用或正被占用。游戏将不播放CD音轨。
en: CD unavailable or in use. GTA will run without CD audio.

zh: 光头索内蒂让我警告你。
en: I got a warning for you from Bald Man Sonetti.

zh: 再惹他，我就把枪塞进你屁股……
en: Cross him again, I stick a gun up your ass...

zh: 干得不错，小子，可事情已经炸了。
en: Nice work kid but the shit's hit the fan.

zh: 条子打着手电往我屁股里爬，就为了找你。
en: The cops are crawling up my ass with flashlights looking for you.

zh: 我给你订了去圣安地列斯的机票。
en: I booked you a flight to San Andreas.

zh: 我们正在建立一桩规模惊人的犯罪集团。
en: We are building a crime syndicate of extraordinary magnitude.

zh: 我们按祖宗的规矩收保护费。
en: We extort money in the tradition of our ancestors.
You done real good for me.

zh: 现在你该知道他们为什么叫我驴子了！
en: Now it's time for you to find out why they call me the donkey!
I'm going to reward you personally this time!

zh: 听好了，你这廉价的吮妈货！
en: You listen to me you two-bit mother sucker!

zh: 我听说你在背着我干活。
en: I hear you're working behind my back.

zh: 要是真的，我就把你当疯婊子那样干！
en: If that's true, I'm gonna you like a crazy bitch!
I got the idea that you got the job done.

zh: 我觉得很长一段时间见不着你了！
en: I don't think I'll be seeing you for a long time!

zh: 没有《侠盗猎车手》光盘。@@只能加入网络游戏。@@带上光盘重新启动，才能正常玩。
en: The Grand Theft Auto CD is not present.@@Only joining network games is possible.@@Start Grand Theft Auto again with the CD present for normal play.
OK, one more should do it!

zh: 你的老大对进度不满意。你还能活着就算走运。不过公司可能会让你后悔没死。
en: Your boss is not happy with your progress. You're lucky to still be alive. However, the company may make you wish you had died.

zh: 你以为老大会把你捞出来。公司没人替你说话。
en: You thought that your boss would have tried to get you off. No-one from the company is around to defend you.

zh: 真是个人物！你妈会骄傲的！
en: What a guy! Your momma would be proud!

zh: 怂包，嗯？下次我去商场给你带根脊梁回来！
en: Chicken-shit, huh? Next time I'm at the mall I'll bring ya back a spine!

zh: 这么简单的活要拖他妈多久？你输得难看。公司不高兴。
en: How god-damn-long can such a simple mission take you? You have failed miserably. The company is not happy.

zh: 时间到！%s以%d块巨款获胜，%s以%d块屈居第二。
en: TIME UP! %s WINS with a monumental $%d, %s brings up second with %d.
%s HITS THE TARGET! The winning score is %d!
